headline: Contested Belt Sees Fresh Base Fighting
war_summary: The newest returns show the contested belt broadening, with Gutter and WeatheredExpanse still the chief maelstroms. Gutter has risen to 83 strategic-base events in 24 hours from 73, with fighting accelerating sharply; its ledger now shows two Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral holdings. WeatheredExpanse has reached 50 events from 44, with casualties and enlistments quickening, while four bases are Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral. OlavisWake is the freshest flashpoint, recording all eight of its daily events in the latest two hours amid a sudden surge in casualties and enlistments; three holdings remain Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral. PalantineBerm has edged to 25 events and now lists all seven bases as Colonial, after a day of repeated neutralizations and captures. MarbanHollow remains unsettled at 21 events, with both casualty streams accelerating, while StlicanShelf has climbed to 11 events and continues to see heavy, rising losses. NevishLine has cooled to 18 daily events. The war remains without a declared victor.
